daas-irab:126-127.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition of comparison taking the genitive, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the kāf; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "الأمر كذلك". ﴿أَتَتْكَ﴾ a past verb, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آياتُنا﴾ fāʿil (agent), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَنَسِيتَها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the kāf is a preposition of comparison taking the genitive and ذا is a demonstrative in the genitive; the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿تُنْسى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; كذلك: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of a mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَسْرَفَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of a relative noun. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لم is jussive-governing. ﴿يُؤْمِنْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ the two are attached to يؤمن. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَعَذابُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the lām is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ). ﴿عذاب﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾ khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾ conjoined to أشد; the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:128-129.t: ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for reproachful interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لم is a jussive-governing particle. ﴿يَهْدِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; its fāʿil (agent) is the maṣdar (verbal noun) understood from أهلكنا. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يهد. ﴿كَمْ﴾ it is the declarative (khabariyya) kam, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أهلكنا. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ may be parsed as the fāʿil of يهد. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted tamyīz (specification) of the declarative كم. ﴿يَمْشُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from القرون. ﴿فِي مَساكِنِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يمشون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ the preposition and the demonstrative are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is the postponed noun of إن, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِأُولِي﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt of آيات. ﴿النُّهى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra; النهى means minds (intellects). ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لولا is conditional, not jussive-governing. ﴿كَلِمَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar obligatorily omitted, its implied form being "موجودة". ﴿سَبَقَتْ﴾ the clause is a naʿt of كلمة. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ the two are attached to سبقت. ﴿لَكانَ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of لولا, and كان is the incomplete (nāqiṣa) one, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لِزاماً﴾ khabar of كان. ﴿وَأَجَلٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أجل is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to كلمة. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ naʿt of أجل, nominative with an implied ḍamma; the clause لكان is the apodosis of لولا and has no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿لَوْلا﴾ … etc. is resumptive.

daas-irab:130-131.t: ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption, and اصبر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اصبر. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿وَسَبِّحْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and سبح is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to اصبر. ﴿بِحَمْدِ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "وأنت حامد". ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿طُلُوعِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الشَّمْسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقَبْلَ﴾ conjoined to قبل. ﴿غُرُوبِها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and من is a preposition. ﴿آناءِ﴾ a genitive noun; the two are attached to سبح. ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَسَبِّحْ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and سبح is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَطْرافَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أطراف is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿النَّهارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَعَلَّكَ﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿تَرْضى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعل, and the clause ﴿لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضى..﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of سبح. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَمُدَّنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive لا; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun. ﴿عَيْنَيْكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun; the two are attached to تمدن, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَتَّعْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to متعنا. ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi; أزواجا means kinds (classes). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective). ﴿زَهْرَةَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of متع; this is permissible because the meaning of متع is "gave". ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ a naʿt, genitive (majrūr) with an implied kasra; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); نفتنهم is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of causation; the fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the lām and its genitive are attached to متعنا. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to نفتنهم. ﴿وَرِزْقُ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, and رزق is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أبقى is conjoined to خير; it is nominative like it, with an implied ḍamma on its end, its appearance prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:132-133.t: ﴿وَأْمُرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أمر [an imperative verb], its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿أَهْلَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). بالصلاة: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb وأمر. [Translator's note: the source places بالصلاة inside the analysis of ﴿أَهْلَكَ﴾ without brackets.] ﴿وَاصْطَبِرْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to وأمر. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to اصطبر. ﴿لا نَسْئَلُكَ﴾ لا is negating; نسألك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَرْزُقُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالْعاقِبَةُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and العاقبة is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلتَّقْوى﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive, and the preceding clause likewise. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿يَأْتِينا﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and نا is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to يأتينا. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and the wāw conjoins to an implied, omitted [clause], its implied form being "ألم تأتهم البينات تترى وألم تأتهم بصورة خاصة ما في الصحف الأولى" (Have not the clear proofs come to them in succession, and has not there come to them, in particular, what is in the former scriptures?). ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-governing particle. ﴿تَأْتِهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by deletion of the weak letter, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَيِّنَةُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute) or muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الصُّحُفِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿الْأُولى﴾ naʿt of الصحف, genitive (majrūr) like it with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on its end.

daas-irab:134-135.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and لو is a conditional particle, not jussive-governing. ﴿أَنَّا﴾ أن, and نا is its noun. ﴿أَهْلَكْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن, and the clause ﴿أَنَّا أَهْلَكْناهُمْ﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾ the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أهلكناهم. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَقالُوا﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو, and قالوا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative (manṣūb), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أَرْسَلْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to أرسلت. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَنَتَّبِعَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and the imperfect verb is accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the fāʾ of causation; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿آياتِكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ the two are attached to نتبع. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿نَذِلَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by أن, its fāʿil latent; أن and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَنَخْزى﴾ conjoined to نذل. ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause of the imperative verb and its fāʿil is resumptive. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُتَرَبِّصٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَتَرَبَّصُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); تربصوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, its implied form being "إذا كان الأمر كذلك فتربصوا". ﴿فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and the imperfect verb is nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾ khabar of من; the clause fills the place of the two objects of فستعلمون. ﴿الصِّراطِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿السَّوِيِّ﴾ naʿt of الصراط. ﴿وَمَنِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and من is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿اهْتَدى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of من, and the clause ﴿مَنِ اهْتَدى﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to من أصحاب.

daas-irab:1-4.t: ﴿طه﴾ one of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) of the Qur'an, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); it was also read نزلنا. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا. ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لِتَشْقى﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and تشقى is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). Al-shaqāʾ here means toil. The implied an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the lām, [the two being] attached to أنزلنا. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿تَذْكِرَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the exception here is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ). ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the lām is a preposition and man is a relative noun; [the two are] attached to تذكرة. ﴿يَخْشى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَنْزِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "نزلنا". ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ min is a preposition and man is a relative noun; [the two are] attached to تنزيلا. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالسَّماواتِ﴾ conjoined to الأرض, and it is accusative like it; the sign of its accusative is the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿الْعُلى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of السموات, and it is accusative like it by the fatḥa implied on the alif owing to impossibility.

daas-irab:5-8.t: ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) استوى. ﴿اسْتَوى﴾ a past verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to ما في السموات. ﴿وَما بَيْنَهُما﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما تَحْتَ﴾ the adverb is attached to the omitted ṣila of mā. ﴿الثَّرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; in is conditional. ﴿تَجْهَرْ﴾ the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿بِالْقَوْلِ﴾ attached to تجهر; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and inna and its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿السِّرَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَأَخْفى﴾ conjoined to السر, by the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun; its khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود". ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun implied in the omitted khabar; the clause لا إله is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿الْأَسْماءُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْحُسْنى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative by the implied ḍamma; the clause له الأسماء is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:9-13.t: ﴿وَهَلْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and hal is an interrogative particle. ﴿أَتاكَ﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿حَدِيثُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُوسى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no position. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) حديث. ﴿رَأى ناراً﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the clause رأى. ﴿لِأَهْلِهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿امْكُثُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the alif is for separation; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿آنَسْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause gives the reason for the command. ﴿ناراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾ laʿalla and its noun. ﴿آتِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of laʿalla, in the position of nominative. ﴿مِنْها﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of قبس. ﴿بِقَبَسٍ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَجِدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَى النَّارِ﴾ attached to أجد. ﴿هُدىً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿لما﴾ an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna). ﴿أَتاها﴾ a past verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿نُودِيَ﴾ a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ yā is a vocative particle and موسى is the one addressed (munādā). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ the khabar of أنا; the clause is the khabar of إني. ﴿فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb and its object; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause has no position, [being] the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿بِالْوادِ﴾ attached to the khabar. ﴿الْمُقَدَّسِ﴾ a genitive adjective (ṣifa). ﴿طُوىً﴾ badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); Ṭuwā is the name of the valley. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and أنا is mubtadaʾ. ﴿اخْتَرْتُكَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿فَاسْتَمِعْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; استمع is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun. ﴿لِما﴾ attached to استمع. ﴿يُوحى﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.

daas-irab:14-16.t: ﴿إِنَّنِي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود". ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنَا﴾ badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun implied in the khabar. ﴿فَاعْبُدْنِي﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no position. The clause لا إله إلا أنا is a second khabar, and the clause ﴿وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ﴾ is conjoined to فاعبدني. ﴿لِذِكْرِي﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقم. ﴿إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَكادُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation; its noun is latent, its implied form being "أنا"; the clause is a second khabar. ﴿أُخْفِيها﴾ the clause is the khabar of أكاد. ﴿لِتُجْزى﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and تجزى is a passive imperfect verb. ﴿كُلُّ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the lām of causation. ﴿بِما﴾ attached to the verb تجزى. ﴿تَسْعى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; lā is prohibitive. ﴿يَصُدَّنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive by the prohibitive lā; the nūn of emphasis is a particle with no grammatical position, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَنْها﴾ attached to يصدنك. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُ﴾ lā is negative; يؤمن is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِها﴾ attached to the verb; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of a relative. ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ هَواهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; هواه is mafʿūl bihi and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتَرْدى﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and تردى is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun.

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative — the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address — in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿بِيَمِينِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the demonstrative; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ yā is for the vocative, and موسى is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the implied (muqaddar) أدعو; the vocative clause is resumptive, and likewise the clause that preceded it. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿هِيَ عَصايَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the yāʾ in عصاي is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿أَتَوَكَّؤُا﴾ and ﴿أَهُشُّ﴾ two imperfect verbs, the fāʿil of each being latent in it; the clause أتوكأ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause ﴿أَهُشُّ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ attached to أتوكأ. ﴿بِها﴾ attached to أهش, and likewise ﴿عَلى غَنَمِي﴾. ﴿وَلِيَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لي is attached to a fronted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ ﴿مَآرِبُ﴾, and ﴿فِيها﴾ is attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أُخْرى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of مآرب; the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.

daas-irab:19-23.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلْقِها﴾ an imperative verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ the vocative clause is also the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَأَلْقاها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being "هو"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and idhā of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya) is an adverb of time. ﴿هِيَ حَيَّةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَسْعى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of حية. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿خُذْها﴾ an imperative verb and its object; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قال. ﴿وَلا تَخَفْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive; تخف is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَنُعِيدُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿سِيرَتَهَا﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the implied form being "إلى سيرتها"; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْأُولى﴾ an adjective of سيرتها, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra implied on the alif maqṣūra. [Translator's note: so in the source; since سيرتها is accusative by the source's own analysis, its adjective would be accusative by the implied fatḥa.] ﴿وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ﴾ the clause consisting of the verb, its latent fāʿil and its object is conjoined. ﴿إِلى جَناحِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) اضمم. ﴿تَخْرُجْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَيْضاءَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ غَيْرِ﴾ attached to بيضاء. ﴿سُوءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آيَةً﴾ a ḥāl of the latent fāʿil of تخرج. ﴿أُخْرى﴾ an adjective of آية. ﴿لِنُرِيَكَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; its fāʿil is latent and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the lām. ﴿مِنْ آياتِنَا﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl of الكبرى. ﴿الْكُبْرى﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. The meaning of جناحك is "your side", and the meaning of ﴿مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ﴾ is "without ugliness"; it is an allusion to leprosy (al-baraṣ), the well-known disease. That is, Allah gave our master Moses the miracle of the hand: when he brought it out from under his side it came out intensely white without leprosy — a sign among the nine signs that Allah gave our master Moses as miracles bearing witness to the truth of his message.

daas-irab:24-32.t: ﴿اذْهَبْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) اذهب; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿طَغى﴾ the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿قالَ رَبِّ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. رب is the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; رب is a munādā annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person. ﴿اشْرَحْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾ attached to اشرح. ﴿صَدْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause and what precedes it are the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَيَسِّرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and يسر is a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾ attached to يسر. ﴿أَمْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to the clause اشرح لي صدري. ﴿وَاحْلُلْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; احلل is a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عُقْدَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ لِسانِي﴾ attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of عقدة; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَفْقَهُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request, by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿قَوْلِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاجْعَلْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and اجعل is a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾ attached to a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَزِيراً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِي﴾ attached to an adjective of وزيرا. ﴿هارُونَ﴾ badal (substitute) of وزيرا. ﴿أَخِي﴾ badal of هارون. ﴿اشْدُدْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to اشدد. ﴿أَزْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَشْرِكْهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause أشركه is conjoined to اشدد. ﴿فِي أَمْرِي﴾ attached to أشركه.

daas-irab:33-36.t: ﴿كَيْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿نُسَبِّحَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the verb is accusative (manṣūb) by kay. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "تسبيحا كثيرا"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيراً﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿بِنا﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) بصيرا. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ the khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أُوتِيتَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is the first object. [Translator's note: so in the source; أوتيت is a past verb.] ﴿سُؤْلَكَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ yā is a vocative particle; موسى is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the implied (muqaddar) أدعو.

daas-irab:37-40.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿مَنَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb مننا. ﴿مَرَّةً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أُخْرى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of مرة, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to مننا. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلى أُمِّكَ﴾ attached to أوحينا; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُوحى﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿أَنِ﴾ a particle of explanation (tafsīr), because revelation (al-waḥy) has the meaning of saying. ﴿اقْذِفِيهِ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فِي التَّابُوتِ﴾ attached to اقذفيه; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no position. ﴿فَاقْذِفِيهِ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and اقذفيه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فِي الْيَمِّ﴾ attached to اقذفيه; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَلْيُلْقِهِ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and the lām is the lām of command; يلقه is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْيَمِّ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِالسَّاحِلِ﴾ attached to يلقه; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَأْخُذْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿لِي﴾ attached to عدو. ﴿وَعَدُوٌّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and عدو is conjoined to what precedes it; the verbal clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to عدو. ﴿وَأَلْقَيْتُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَلْقَيْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿مَحَبَّةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنِّي﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of محبة; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِتُصْنَعَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and a passive imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation. ﴿عَلى عَيْنِي﴾ attached to تصنع; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to ألقيت. ﴿تَمْشِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ. ﴿أُخْتُكَ﴾ fāʿil; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتَقُولُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿أَدُلُّكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ ʿalā is a preposition and man is a relative noun; both are attached to أدلكم. ﴿يَكْفُلُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative. ﴿فَرَجَعْناكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and رجعناك is a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿إِلى أُمِّكَ﴾ attached to رجعناك; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَيْ﴾ a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿تَقَرَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by kay. ﴿عَيْنُها﴾ its fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا تَحْزَنَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive, and an accusative imperfect verb; the clause is conjoined to كي تقر. [Translator's note: so in the source; since تحزن is accusative, conjoined to تقر, the lā here is negative (nāfiya), not prohibitive.] ﴿وَقَتَلْتَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿نَفْساً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَنَجَّيْناكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْغَمِّ﴾ attached to نجيناك. ﴿وَفَتَنَّاكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فُتُوناً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿فَلَبِثْتَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿سِنِينَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to لبثت. ﴿فِي أَهْلِ﴾ attached to لبثت. ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, a diptote, what prevents it [from full declension] being its being a proper noun and feminine. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿جِئْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى قَدَرٍ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ of the fāʿil. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the implied (muqaddar) أدعو.

daas-irab:41-42.t: ﴿وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿لِنَفْسِي﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) اصطنعتك; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿اذْهَبْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَخُوكَ﴾ conjoined to the latent fāʿil أنت; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِآياتِي﴾ the bāʾ is for accompaniment (muṣāḥaba); [the two are] attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَنِيا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā by the deletion of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil. ﴿فِي ذِكْرِي﴾ attached to تنيا; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:43-45.t: ﴿اذْهَبا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) اذهبا; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿طَغى﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause ﴿إِنَّهُ طَغى﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿فَقُولا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ is an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the alif is its fāʿil. [Translator's note: the source cites the word here as ﴿قَوْلًا﴾, but the analysis is of the imperative قُولا.] ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to قولا. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿لَيِّناً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَعَلَّهُ﴾ laʿalla and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُ﴾ a nominative imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of laʿalla. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَخْشى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the implied ḍamma; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf); nā is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the vocative clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿إِنَّنا﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿نَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿يَفْرُطَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ attached to يفرط. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿يَطْغى﴾ an accusative imperfect verb; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:46-47.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَخافا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿إِنَّنِي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مَعَكُما﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and the mā is for the dual; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿أَسْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَرى﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَأْتِياهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); ائتياه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَقُولا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قولا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿رَسُولا﴾ the khabar of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif because it is a dual; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَرْسِلْ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; أرسل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَعَنا﴾ an adverb of place, attached to أرسل. ﴿بَنِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُعَذِّبْهُمْ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of آية; the clause قد جئناك is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿السَّلامُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى مَنِ﴾ the preposition and the relative noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اتَّبَعَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْهُدى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility.

daas-irab:48-49.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أُوحِيَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. [Translator's note: so in the source; أوحي is a past verb.] ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحي. ﴿أَنَّ الْعَذابَ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ the preposition and the relative noun are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿كَذَّبَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَتَوَلَّى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and تولى is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). [Translator's note: so in the source; تولى here is a past verb.] ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the conjunctive one, and man is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبُّكُما﴾ khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm and alif are for the dual; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾ the one addressed (munādā); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:50-52.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿رَبُّنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿أَعْطى﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كُلَّ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَلْقَهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ هَدى﴾ the clause is conjoined to أعطى. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿بالُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْقُرُونِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأُولى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive (majrūr) by the implied (muqaddara) kasra; the clause فما بال etc. is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿عِلْمُها﴾ mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] also attached to the khabar. ﴿لا يَضِلُّ﴾ lā is negative; يضل is an imperfect verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ fāʿil (agent); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَنْسى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma. In the verse is the declaration of Allah the Exalted's transcendence above error and forgetfulness. The clause ﴿لا يَضِلُّ﴾ etc. is resumptive, and the clause ﴿لا يَنْسى﴾ is conjoined to لا يضل; the object of ينسى is omitted.

daas-irab:53-55.t: ﴿الَّذِي﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَهْداً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿سَلَكَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ attached to the verb before it. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to سلك. ﴿سُبُلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ attached to أنزل. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أخرجنا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to أخرجنا. ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ نَباتٍ﴾ attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of أزواجا. ﴿شَتَّى﴾ an adjective of أزواجا; the clause أخرجنا etc. is conjoined. ﴿كُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ارْعَوْا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنْعامَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ attached to the fronted khabar; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the postponed noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِأُولِي﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of آيات. ﴿النُّهى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿إِنَّ﴾ etc. is resumptive. ﴿مِنْها﴾ attached to خلقناكم. ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to نعيدكم. ﴿نُعِيدُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَمِنْها﴾ attached to نخرجكم. ﴿نُخْرِجُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is "نحن". ﴿تارَةً﴾ an adverb of time, attached to نخرجكم. ﴿أُخْرى﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:56-59.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a preposition of oath, and it and what is sworn by are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of swearing; in ولقد the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿آياتِنا﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); nā is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كُلَّها﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of آيات, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَكَذَّبَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and كذب — the clause is conjoined to أريناه. ﴿وَأَبى﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). The signs that Allah gave our master Moses are nine signs: the hand, the staff, the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, the blood, the years [of drought], and the shortage of fruits. Refer to the commentary on verse 101 of al-Isrāʾ in the Tafsīr of Ibn Kathīr or other commentaries. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَجِئْتَنا﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of قال; the hamza is for rebuking interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī). ﴿لِتُخْرِجَنا﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and تخرجنا is an accusative imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; nā is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿مِنْ أَرْضِنا﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to تخرجنا; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause composed of an and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the lām, and both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿بِسِحْرِكَ﴾ attached to تخرجنا; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾ the one addressed (munādā). ﴿فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath; نأتينك is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِسِحْرٍ﴾ attached to نأتينك. ﴿مِثْلِهِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the answer of the omitted oath. ﴿فَاجْعَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿اجعل﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾ an adverb of time; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; بين is ordinarily classed as an adverb of place.] ﴿وَبَيْنَكَ﴾ conjoined to بيننا. ﴿مَوْعِداً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi of اجعل; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿نُخْلِفُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is an adjective of موعدا. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ tawkīd of the latent pronoun in نخلفه. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ conjoined to the latent pronoun in نخلفه. ﴿مَكاناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سُوىً﴾ an adjective of مكانا, accusative by the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa, i.e. "midway". ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَوْعِدُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الزِّينَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَأَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and an is a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿يُحْشَرَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿ضُحًى﴾ an adverb of time, attached to يحشر; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:60-61.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّى﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَجَمَعَ﴾ a conjoined past verb; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْدَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction indicating delay (tarākhī). ﴿أَتى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿مُوسى﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَيْلَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb which the Arabs let die out while keeping its maṣdar (verbal noun); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَفْتَرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by ʿalā; [the two are] attached to تفتروا. ﴿كَذِباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation; the fāʿil is latent and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾ attached to يسحتكم. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); the clause ﴿خابَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative, the fāʿil of خاب. ﴿افْتَرى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:62-64.t: ﴿فَتَنازَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَمْرَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَأَسَرُّوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined. ﴿النَّجْوى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa) from the heavy inna, with no governing effect. ﴿هذانِ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَساحِرانِ﴾ the lām is the differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and ساحران is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿يُرِيدانِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ساحران. [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil of يريدان is the alif of the dual.] ﴿إِنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. [Translator's note: the source writes ﴿إِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is أَنْ.] ﴿يُخْرِجاكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the deletion of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of يريدان. ﴿مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to يخرجاكم; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِسِحْرِهِما﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَيَذْهَبا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the clause يخرجاكم and is accusative like it. ﴿بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ﴾ attached to يذهبا; the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿الْمُثْلى﴾ an adjective of طريقتكم, genitive (majrūr) by the implied kasra. ﴿فَأَجْمِعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿كَيْدَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, the implied form being "if the matter is … etc., then gather". ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿ائْتُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿صَفًّا﴾ an accusative ḥāl, i.e. "lined up in ranks". ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَفْلَحَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿اسْتَعْلى﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the implied fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:65-67.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾ the one addressed (munādā); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿إِمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing; its meaning here is choice (takhyīr), with an omitted verb implied, "اختر" (choose). ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿تُلْقِيَ﴾ an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb اختر, the implied form being "choose one of the two matters". ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿نَكُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun. [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no wāw in نكون — its noun is the latent pronoun نحن.] ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ the accusative khabar (predicate) of نكون; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَلْقى﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause); an and what follows it are in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb اختر. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَلْقُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and idhā of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿حِبالُهُمْ﴾ a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿عِصِيُّهُمْ﴾ conjoined to حبالهم; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is initial. ﴿يُخَيَّلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma on its last letter; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخيل. ﴿مِنْ سِحْرِهِمْ﴾ attached to يخيل; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنَّها﴾ anna and its noun; anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar serving as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿تَسْعى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿فَأَوْجَسَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause of the verb أوجس and its fāʿil is conjoined. ﴿فِي نَفْسِهِ﴾ attached to أوجس; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خِيفَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُوسى﴾ a postponed fāʿil.

daas-irab:68-70.t: ﴿قُلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَخَفْ﴾ a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قلنا. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun. ﴿الْأَعْلى﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَلْقِ﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun whose position is accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي يَمِينِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of mā; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَلْقَفْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿صَنَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila. ﴿إن﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿ما﴾ the relative [mā] is its noun; the clause is resumptive, with no position. ﴿صَنَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no position. ﴿كَيْدُ﴾ the khabar of inna. ﴿ساحِرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and lā is negative. ﴿يُفْلِحُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿السَّاحِرُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ an adverb of place indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to يفلح; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) — or the wāw is a conjunction and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَتى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأُلْقِيَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ألقي is a passive past verb. ﴿السَّحَرَةُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿سُجَّداً﴾ ḥāl; the clause is conjoined to an implied (muqaddara) clause, namely "Moses threw his staff, and the sorcerers were thrown down". ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as another ḥāl of السحرة. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿بِرَبِّ﴾ attached to آمنا. ﴿هارُونَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَمُوسى﴾ conjoined by the wāw, genitive like it, by the kasra implied on the alif maqṣūra owing to impossibility. [Translator's note: so in the source; موسى is likewise a diptote, so its implied genitive sign would be the fatḥa.]

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿لَهُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنتم. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to آمنتم. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿آذَنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to آذن; the clause أن آذن is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَكَبِيرُكُمُ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and كبيركم is the khabar (predicate) of inna; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, an adjective (ṣifa) in the position of nominative. ﴿عَلَّمَكُمُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿السِّحْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath; أقطعن is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the nūn is a particle with no grammatical position; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَيْدِيَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ خِلافٍ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the meaning being "on opposite sides"; the clause has no position. ﴿وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is latent and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فِي جُذُوعِ﴾ attached to أصلبنكم. ﴿النَّخْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the lām occurs in the answer of the oath; the imperfect verb is nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn — which was deleted because of the succession of like letters — since it is one of the five verbs; the wāw, deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and the nūn is the nūn of emphasis, with no position. ﴿أَيُّنا﴾ the interrogative ayy, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾ khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of تعلمن, because the verb is suspended (ʿulliqa) by the interrogative ayy. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾ conjoined to أشد.

daas-irab:72-74.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿نُؤْثِرَكَ﴾ an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun; [the two are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) نؤثرك. ﴿جاءَنا﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; nā is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْبَيِّناتِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a preposition of oath, and the relative noun is in the position of genitive; [the two are] attached to the omitted verb أقسم. ﴿فَطَرَنا﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; nā is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of a relative. ﴿فَاقْضِ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and اقض is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قاضٍ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the deleted yāʾ because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ); the clause is the ṣila, with no position. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿تَقْضِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَياةَ﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause has no grammatical position because it is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بِرَبِّنا﴾ attached to آمنا; nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are in the position of genitive by the lām, and both are attached to آمنا. ﴿لَنا﴾ attached to يغفر. ﴿خَطايانا﴾ an accusative mafʿūl bihi; nā is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to خطايانا. ﴿أَكْرَهْتَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to أكرهتنا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ السِّحْرِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the mubtadaʾ and khabar are a conjoined clause. ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾ conjoined to خير in the nominative. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُجْرِماً﴾ ḥāl. The clause of man is the khabar of inna, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إن﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ its postponed noun; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the apodosis is joined with the linking fāʾ because the apodosis clause is a nominal clause. ﴿لا يَمُوتُ﴾ lā is negative, and the imperfect verb's fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to يموت; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَلا يَحْيى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative; يحيا is an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on its last letter; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa).

daas-irab:75-76.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَأْتِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), by the deletion of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate). ﴿مُؤْمِناً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of مؤمنا. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar. ﴿الدَّرَجاتُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿الْعُلى﴾ an adjective of الدرجات. ﴿جَنَّاتُ﴾ badal (substitute) of الدرجات. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ attached to تجري; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to خالدين; the clause تجري is an adjective of جنات. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿جَزاءُ﴾ khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَزَكَّى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position; the clause of the mubtadaʾ and khabar is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). [Translator's note: so in the source; تزكى here is a past verb.]

daas-irab:77-79.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلى مُوسى﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحينا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative (mufassira). ﴿أَسْرِ﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِعِبادِي﴾ attached to أسر; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. ﴿فَاضْرِبْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined; the meaning is "make". ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to اضرب, and the two stand in place of the second object. ﴿طَرِيقاً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of طريقا. ﴿يَبَساً﴾ a second adjective. ﴿لا تَخافُ﴾ lā is negative, and the imperfect verb's fāʿil is latent. ﴿دَرَكاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا تَخْشى﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; أتبعهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿بِجُنُودِهِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَغَشِيَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; غشيهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْيَمِّ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun whose position is nominative as fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿غَشِيَهُمْ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَوْمَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿هَدى﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:80-81.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بَنِي﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْجَيْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿مِنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنجيناكم; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَواعَدْناكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جانِبَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الطُّورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَيْمَنَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of جانب; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَنَزَّلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and نزلنا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ attached to نزلنا. ﴿الْمَنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالسَّلْوى﴾ conjoined to المن; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the alif is for separation. ﴿مِنْ طَيِّباتِ﴾ attached to كلوا. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "قال … etc.". ﴿رَزَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَطْغَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ attached to تطغوا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَيَحِلَّ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and يحل is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to يحل. ﴿غَضَبِي﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is conditional, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَحْلِلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to يحلل. ﴿غَضَبِي﴾ fāʿil; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and qad is a particle of realisation. ﴿هَوى﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:82-84.t: ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَغَفَّارٌ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); غفار is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the lām is a preposition. ﴿من﴾ a relative noun. ﴿تابَ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause); the clause إني is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَآمَنَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿صالِحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اهْتَدى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْجَلَكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَنْ قَوْمِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعجلك; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أُولاءِ﴾ a demonstrative, khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿عَلى أَثَرِي﴾ attached to a second khabar. ﴿وَعَجِلْتُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); عجلت is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ attached to عجلت. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle, accusative; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿لِتَرْضى﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an; the lām and what follows it are attached to ترضى. [Translator's note: so in the source; the lām and what follows it would be attached to عجلت.]

daas-irab:85-87.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); إنا is inna, and nā is its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿فَتَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿قَوْمَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of قومك. ﴿وَأَضَلَّهُمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أضلهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّامِرِيُّ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَرَجَعَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿رجع﴾ a past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ attached to رجع; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غَضْبانَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿أَسِفاً﴾ a second ḥāl; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle for rebuke (inkār), and lam makes [the verb] jussive. ﴿يَعِدْكُمْ﴾ a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ fāʿil; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the vocative clause and the one after it are the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَفَطالَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction; طال is a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ attached to طال. ﴿الْعَهْدُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَرَدْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿يَحِلَّ﴾ an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ attached to يحل. ﴿غَضَبٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ attached to an adjective of غضب; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أردتم. ﴿فَأَخْلَفْتُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخلفتم is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَوْعِدِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿أَخْلَفْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَوْعِدَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِمَلْكِنا﴾ attached to أخلفنا; بملكنا means "by our power"; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākinna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حُمِّلْنا﴾ a passive past verb, and nā is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of lākinna. ﴿أَوْزاراً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of حملنا. ﴿مِنْ زِينَةِ﴾ attached to an adjective of أوزارا. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقَذَفْناها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَكَذلِكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and the kāf is a preposition. ﴿ذا﴾ a demonstrative; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; the demonstrative is in the position of genitive by the kāf, and both are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being "he threw a throwing being … etc.". ﴿أَلْقَى السَّامِرِيُّ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:88-90.t: ﴿فَأَخْرَجَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أخرج is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرج. ﴿عِجْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَسَداً﴾ badal (substitute) of عجلا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خُوارٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿قالوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلهُكُمْ﴾ khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَإِلهُ﴾ conjoined to إلهكم. ﴿مُوسى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَنَسِيَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause نسي is conjoined. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أن﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa) from the heavy [anna]; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), its implied form being "أنه". ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَرْجِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to يرجع. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause يرجع is the khabar of an. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يَمْلِكُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to يملك. ﴿ضَرًّا وَلا نَفْعاً﴾ ضرا is mafʿūl bihi and نفعا is conjoined to it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is for the oath and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ هارُونُ﴾ a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ attached to قال; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of the oath. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿فُتِنْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb; the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to فتنتم; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَاتَّبِعُونِي﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); اتبعوني is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَطِيعُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَمْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited [to the yāʾ]; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:91-94.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿نَبْرَحَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) عاكفين. ﴿عاكِفِينَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of نبرح; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَرْجِعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after ḥattā. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ attached to يرجع. ﴿مُوسى﴾ fāʿil (agent). يرجع and the implied an before it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by ḥattā, and [the two are] attached to عاكفين. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا هارُونُ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā); the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قال. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَنَعَكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of mā. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to منعك. ﴿رَأَيْتَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ضَلُّوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of رأيتهم, on the view that it is [a verb] of the heart (qalbiyya). ﴿أن﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿لا﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿تَتَّبِعَنِ﴾ an accusative imperfect verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil is latent, and the deleted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; it was also read with the yāʾ retained. An and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by an implied preposition, min, and [the two are] attached to the verb. ﴿أَفَعَصَيْتَ﴾ the hamza is for rebuking interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction, and عصيت is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَمْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to an omitted, implied clause.
[Translator's note: from this point the source text is damaged — the brackets around the Quranic cue words are corrupted and several words are truncated. The cue words below are restored from the verse (20:94); the analyses are translated as they stand.]
